name: Disagreement (khilāf)
definition: A question on which the grammarians hold different views; masāʾil al-khilāf are above all the questions disputed between Basra and Kufa.
body: The books mark a question as disputed (fīhi khilāf, 'there is disagreement on it') and then give the views (madhāhib): the Basrans', the Kufans', and those of single grammarians such as al-Akhfash or al-Farrāʾ. Ibn al-Anbārī's al-Inṣāf collects 121 of them, al-ʿUkbarī's al-Tabyīn more; among the best known are whether the maṣdar or the verb is the origin of derivation, whether the mubtadaʾ and the khabar govern each other, and whether niʿma and biʾsa are verbs or nouns.
